# EasyMDE (vendored)

Unmodified `dist/` files from the easymde npm package v2.21.0
(https://github.com/Ionaru/easy-markdown-editor, MIT — see LICENSE).
Used by content/applications/markdown.html, which supplies the ClackOS
skin as its own CSS on top.

To update: replace easymde.min.js/.css with the current npm dist files.
